newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MOSTLY WEAKER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MOSTLY WEAKER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on sterling but weaker against the U.S. dollar, the mark and the rand at the close of Thursday's interbank trading session, dealers said.
"We had a huge influx of tobacco receipts and mineral exports (receipts) and the dollar appreciated up to 11.3685/3785," one dealer said, adding:
"But the (central) Reserve Bank came in and sucked up all the excess liquidity."
He said the central bank's intervention pushed the local unit down to close at 11.3785/3885 on the U.S. dollar, slightly weaker compared to Wednesday's 11.3775/3875.

Against the crosses, the Zimbabwe dollar closed at 18.9890/19.0180 versus sterling from 19.0455/1150, in response to a stronger U.S. dollar overseas, but eased against the mark to 6.3600/3640 from 6.3485/3650 and to 2.4985/4995 on the rand from 2.4975/5075.
